title: What's New: Default Sustainability Information (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Default values for GL accounts, items, resources, and machines
Item sustainability configuration and carbon equivalent calculation
Resource setup and batch carbon equivalent calculation
GL account configuration and purchase invoice setup
Purchase invoice line items with default sustainability values
GL account emissions and availability on other documents

features.name: Default sustainability account on GL account
features.description: Enable setup of default sustainability account values on general ledger accounts. GL accounts receive only sustainability account as default value, not emission values, since different emission values typically apply at posting time.
caveats: GL accounts do not support default emission values

features.name: Default sustainability values on item card
features.description: Enable setup of default sustainability account and gas emissions values on item cards. Fields become editable when replenishment system is set to purchase, non-editable when set to production order or assembly.
caveats: Fields are non-editable for production order or assembly replenishment systems
Must use calculate carbon equivalent action for new items

features.name: Default sustainability values on resource card
features.description: Enable setup of default sustainability account and gas emissions values on resource cards. Users can set default values that transfer to purchase documents.
caveats: Requires calculate carbon equivalent action to populate fields

features.name: Default sustainability values on machine center card
features.description: Enable setup of default sustainability account and gas emissions values on machine center cards in manufacturing.

features.name: Sustainability setup enablement
features.description: New sustainability setup option to enable or disable default sustainability values across master data. When disabled, experience is business as usual. When enabled, new fields appear on GL accounts, items, resources, and machine centers.

features.name: Item charge default sustainability values
features.description: Item charge default sustainability value setup is currently disabled and will be enabled in a future wave as part of complete value chain functionality.
features.status_evidence_quote: Item charge is not enabled yet in this moment. It will be part of next wave because completely uh functionality about value chain is
caveats: Value chain functionality is in public preview

features.name: Calculate carbon equivalent action
features.description: Action available on item and resource cards and on list views to automatically calculate and populate carbon equivalent per unit field based on setup.
caveats: Must be run for new items to populate carbon equivalent fields
Available on list view to update all records at once

features.name: Default sustainability values transfer to purchase documents
features.description: Default sustainability account and emissions values set on master data cards automatically transfer to purchase invoice and purchase order lines. Values are editable in documents.
caveats: Values are defaults only and can be modified in documents
Available on purchase invoice, purchase order, purchase return order, purchase credit memo
